test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six people - Raj, Shruti, Priya, Mohan, Ajit and Geet - are sitting around a circular table facing inside. Mohan is second from Priya's right and Priya is third from Raj's left. Ajit is second from Mohan's right and Geet is not Mohan's neighbour. Who is fourth to the right of Geet?
solution:
According to given information-

 
• Number of persons = 6
 
• Name of persons - Raj, Shruti, Priya, Mohan, Ajit and Geet

​• Mohan is second from Priya's right and Priya is third from Raj's left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23b335a18821de5a2523f48c83ea2b2c97f4246fae07951514971b06756676c9.png] 

• Ajit is second from Mohan's right and Geet is not Mohan's neighbour. Thus, final arrangement will be-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c6456f78561b02a2da39912da83fa71d251b0bb526c02d542128bb3e05da8c5.png] 

Clearly, Raj is sitting fourth to the right of Geet.

Hence, **'option 3' **is the correct answer.

1f
